title: ITW Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of IWD Strapping Sales Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Competition analysis: The merged entity will supply a range of strapping products, including steel, polyester and polypropylene strapping.  The ACCC was satisfied that imports and, for lighter strapping products, suppliers of other unitisation products (for example, shrink and stretch wrap) would be likely to constrain the merged entity.
